decision: Read models.dev once for Anthropic, OpenAI and CommandCode and supply it to both Start and the worker
why: Todd's 24 October decision forbids a hand-edited list; Mastra's registry is generated from models.dev
result: single source used by Start and worker

decision: Add CommandCode's live /provider/v1/models list and published pricing rows for models models.dev lacks
why: Beam is needed for machinery runs and is absent from models.dev under CommandCode; CommandCode publishes its own list and prices
result: Beam offered at $0 with its published context

decision: Refuse a model with no published price or no dispatchable endpoint
why: An unpriced or unroutable offer would fail after selection
result: unpriced and messages-only models absent from offers and present in refused

decision: Refuse CommandCode messages-only models because the stock custom-provider path dispatches chat only
why: Offering a dead route is worse than naming the runtime limit; the same Claude models remain on the Claude subscription route
result: 11 CommandCode Claude entries refused with the reason

decision: Price Claude's one-hour cache writes at twice the published input rate
why: The stock Claude middleware writes one-hour caches; models.dev publishes the five-minute 1.25x rate
result: Opus 5.5 $8 and Sonnet 5.5 $4 per million cache-write tokens settled

decision: Take an 8192-token request output bound from the published maximum
why: An Opus 5.5 reservation at the full 128k output bound exceeds the $2 card cap before any request
result: both real requests reserved and settled below $2

decision: Remove Antigravity and Claude ACP from Start discovery
why: The Start page must offer exactly the three named providers
result: catalogue proof routes are claude, openai-codex, commandcode

decision: Hydrate settings.models and the CommandCode provider list from the catalogue before dispatch
why: The saved card carries selections, not a hand-maintained model table
result: machine-settings test reads no models block

decision: Build pstack helpers only from models named in the selected playbook
why: The catalogue has 133 priced models; one helper per model is unnecessary and amplifies every session
result: helper test expects the two referenced models

decision: Only a preview or latest alias may use its published base row's price; any other unknown model is refused
why: A loose prefix match could borrow a different model's price
result: preview alias priced; unknown preview model refused

decision: Use the real stock Claude subscription sign-in for Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5
why: The card requires one real request each, settled at API price
